modeled_economic_effects: Storage Room sell multipliers 0.9/0.7/0.5 and stock slot losses 1/2/3; generated slot losses persist.
Fog hides naturally connected node contents until the source is cleared, respecting public special markers.
Hope Soil gives one extra random part on an actual covered battle victory.
Actual traversed covered nodes charge 2 gold / 1 shield / 1 HP for improve / correct / radical; noncombat HP costs keep at least 1 HP.
Benefit adds 2 appraisal to each held natural object per actually traversed covered node.
Completing a removable source turns off that region; beneficial event soil is not removable.
combat_effects_not_simulated: Blackflow extra hounds and enemy ATK/HP buffs
Sandstorm direction, ally ATK reductions, enemy movement reductions
Beautiful New Earth ally visual concealment

event_only_ideologies.希望的沃土: Actual 呼吸的红苔 outcome queues the next ordinary region; not part of the ordinary region draw.
event_only_ideologies.美丽新大地: Actual 安眠一隅 outcome only; trigger probability is unknown and the observation-only prototype is not wired into training.

limitations: These raw descriptions do not supply combat outcomes, server region selection weights or event trigger probabilities.
Recorded descriptions are not implemented combat mechanics; evaluations retain the declared victory oracle.
Current sampling produces at most one ordinary region using explicitly declared center, ideology and policy priors.
